subject: Using stat_bin count to calculate y

messages.author: 1d7fa0b0c073a2ce
messages.subject: Using stat_bin count to calculate y
parts:
ggurus,

I have data that contains a dependent variable (interp_dbh), weighting
factor (baf) and group membership (std_id). each group only has one
weighting factor i.e there are no std_id with multiple baf . I am
planning to facet the plot by group membership. I would like to plot a
histogram with the y value calculated as the product of the stat_bin
count * the weighting factor (baf). I have a method for generating the
y values in a python script and passing the values back to ggplot but
wondered if you all might have any suggestions for accomplishing this
just with ggplot . A snippet of the data is shown below.

Thanks very much,

Peter

interp_dbh | baf | std_id
------------+-----+--------
30.7517 | 40 | 202
21.0084 | 40 | 301
20.063 | 40 | 301
